summary: Paladins are plate-wearing holy warriors who heal, tank or fight in melee, using Seals and Judgements, Blessings and Auras. In Forever they gain a baseline Holy Strike, a tanking Seal of Fury, and several new talent abilities.
talent_levels_note: A talent ability can be taken once you can reach its row: the first talent point comes at level 10 and each row needs 5 more points, so row N opens at level 10 + 5 × (N − 1). Talent rows are from wowforevertalent.com; the Forever tooltips of Divine Favor and Templar's Bulwark (20), Seal of Command (20), Holy Shock (30), Holy Shield (30) and Light's Vigil (40) show the same levels or are consistent with them.

abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.text: Heals a friendly target for 42 to 50.
abilities.summary: Heals a friendly target for 42 to 50.

abilities.name: Flash of Light
abilities.text: Heals a friendly target for 48 to 54.
abilities.summary: Heals a friendly target for 48 to 54.

abilities.name: Lay on Hands
abilities.text: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health. Drains all of the Paladin's remaining Mana when used, but does not interrupt Mana regeneration.
abilities.summary: Heals a friendly target for an amount equal to the Paladin's maximum health.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.text: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.
abilities.summary: Cleanses a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 magic effect.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.text: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.
abilities.summary: Purifies the friendly target, removing 1 disease effect and 1 poison effect.

abilities.name: Redemption
abilities.text: Brings a dead player back to life with 65 health and 120 mana. Cannot be cast when in combat.
abilities.summary: Brings a dead player back to life with 65 health and 120 mana.

abilities.name: Exorcism
abilities.text: Causes 80 to 90 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.
abilities.summary: Causes 80 to 90 Holy damage to an Undead or Demon target.

abilities.name: Holy Wrath
abilities.text: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 368 to 434 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds and stunning them for 2 sec.
abilities.summary: Sends bolts of holy power in all directions, causing 368 to 434 Holy damage to all Undead and Demon targets within 20 yds and stunning them for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Hammer of Wrath
abilities.text: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 286 to 314 Holy damage. Only usable on enemies that have 20% or less health.
abilities.summary: Hurls a hammer that strikes an enemy for 286 to 314 Holy damage.

abilities.note: Learned from the trainer at level 20 in Forever; it was a Holy talent in Classic.
abilities.name: Consecration
abilities.text: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area. The first 4 enemies who enter the area will take an additional 32 damage over 8 sec.
abilities.summary: Consecrates the land beneath the Paladin, doing 16 Holy damage over 8 sec to enemies who enter the area.

abilities.name: Seal of Righteousness
abilities.text: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional [(216 / 87 + (0.0765 * Spell Power))] to [(216 / 25 + (0.12 * Spell Power))] Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional [(216 / 87 + (0.0765 * Spell Power))] to [(216 / 25 + (0.12 * Spell Power))] Holy damage.

abilities.name: Seal of the Crusader
abilities.text:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 35 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 23. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
abilities.summary: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 35 melee attack power.

abilities.name: Seal of Light
abilities.text:
Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 25. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
abilities.summary: Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39.

abilities.name: Seal of Wisdom
abilities.text:
Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 33 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
abilities.summary: Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana.

abilities.name: Blessing of Wisdom
abilities.text: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 12 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, restoring 12 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Wisdom
abilities.text: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 36 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Wisdom, restoring 36 mana every 5 seconds for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Sense Undead
abilities.text: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled. Only one type of tracking can be used at a time.
abilities.summary: Shows the location of all nearby undead on the minimap until cancelled.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.text: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 10 sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only one target can be turned at a time.
abilities.summary: The targeted undead enemy will be compelled to flee for up to 10 sec.

abilities.name: Divine Favor
abilities.text: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.
abilities.summary: When activated, gives your next Flash of Light, Holy Light, or Holy Shock spell a 100% critical effect chance.

abilities.note: Swear an Oath to one ally to boost your healing on them.
abilities.name: Oath of Light
abilities.text: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 1 hour, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 0, your Flash of Light by up to 0, and your Holy Shock by up to 0. Only one Oath of Light may be sworn by the Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Swear an Oath to protect target ally for 1 hour, increasing the healing of your Holy Light on them by up to 0, your Flash of Light by up to 0, and your Holy Shock by up to 0.

abilities.name: Holy Shock
abilities.text: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.
abilities.summary: Blasts the target with Holy energy, causing 129 to 139 Holy damage to an enemy, or 110 to 118 healing to an ally.

abilities.note: Rank 1 is a talent; later ranks come at levels 50 and 60.
abilities.name: Light's Vigil
abilities.text: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec. The caster's next Holy Shock on the target incurs no cooldown and heals the target and their party for 326 to 344. Only one Vigil per Paladin may be active in each party.
abilities.summary: Applies Light's Vigil to a friendly target for 30 sec.

abilities.name: Blessing of Freedom
abilities.text: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, granting immunity to movement impairing effects for 10 sec.

abilities.note: Trainable at level 20 in Forever; it was a Holy talent in Classic.
abilities.name: Blessing of Kings
abilities.text: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Kings
abilities.text: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Kings, increasing total stats by 10% for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Blessing of Protection
abilities.text: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
abilities.summary: A targeted party member is protected from all physical attacks for 6 sec, but during that time they cannot attack or use physical abilities.

abilities.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
abilities.text: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 45 damage taken per hit to the caster. Lasts 30 sec. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Places a Blessing on the party member, transfering 45 damage taken per hit to the caster.

abilities.name: Concentration Aura
abilities.text: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives a 35% chance of ignoring spell interruption when damaged to all party members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Devotion Aura
abilities.text: Gives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives 55 additional armor to party members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Shadow Resistance Aura
abilities.text: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Frost Resistance Aura
abilities.text: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives 30 additional Frost resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance Aura
abilities.text: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives 30 additional Fire resistance to all party and raid members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Divine Intervention
abilities.text: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way. Enemies will stop attacking the protected party member, who will be immune to all harmful attacks but cannot take any action for 3 min.
abilities.summary: The paladin sacrifices himself to remove the targeted party member from harms way.

abilities.name: Divine Protection
abilities.text: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 6 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
abilities.summary: You are protected from all physical attacks and spells for 6 sec, but during that time you cannot attack or use physical abilities yourself.

abilities.name: Divine Shield
abilities.text: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
abilities.summary: Protects the paladin from all damage and spells for 10 sec, but reduces all damage you deal by 50%.

abilities.name: Righteous Fury
abilities.text: Increases all threat generated by 33%, and all threat generated by your Holy attacks by an additional 90%. Lasts 30 min.
abilities.summary: Increases all threat generated by 33%, and all threat generated by your Holy attacks by an additional 90%.

abilities.name: Hammer of Justice
abilities.text: Stuns the target for 3 sec.
abilities.summary: Stuns the target for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Seal of Justice
abilities.text:
Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
abilities.summary: Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec.

abilities.name: Seal of Fury
abilities.text:
Fills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Unleashing this Seal's energy inflicts 32 to 34 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 3 sec.
abilities.summary: Fills you with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 6 Holy damage.

abilities.name: Templar's Bulwark
abilities.text: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec. Applies Forbearance for 1 min. Cannot be cast while Forbearance is active.
abilities.summary: When activated, this ability grants you an absorb shield equal to 100% of your maximum health for 8 sec.

abilities.note: A second Judgement with its own cooldown.
abilities.name: Swift Judgement
abilities.text: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect. Does not share a cooldown with your Judgement ability.
abilities.summary: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy.

abilities.name: Holy Shield
abilities.text: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 75 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active. Damage caused by Holy Shield causes 20% additional threat. Each block expends a charge. 4 charges.
abilities.summary: Increases chance to block by 30% for 10 sec, and deals 75 Holy damage for each attack blocked while active.

abilities.name: Blessing of Might
abilities.text: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 14 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Places a Blessing on the friendly target, increasing melee attack power by 14 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Greater Blessing of Might
abilities.text: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 112 for 1 hour. Players may only have one Blessing on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Gives all members of the raid or group that share the same class with the target the Greater Blessing of Might, increasing melee attack power by 112 for 1 hour.

abilities.name: Judgement
abilities.text: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy. Does not consume the Seal. Refer to individual Seals for Judgement effect.
abilities.summary: Unleash the energy of a Seal spell upon an enemy.

abilities.name: Retribution Aura
abilities.text: Causes 5 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards. Players may only have one Aura on them per Paladin at any one time.
abilities.summary: Causes 5 Holy damage to any creature that strikes a party member within 30 yards.

abilities.note: Baseline Retribution strike, new in Forever.
abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.text: An instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage.
abilities.summary: An instant strike that causes 25% weapon damage plus an additional 11 to 14 as Holy damage.

abilities.name: Seal of Command
abilities.text:
Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time. Lasts 30 sec.

Unleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy, instantly causing 69 to 73 Holy damage, 138 to 146 if the target is stunned or incapacitated.
abilities.summary: Gives the Paladin a chance to deal additional Holy damage equal to 70% of normal weapon damage.

abilities.name: Repentance
abilities.text: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec. Any damage caused will awaken the target. Only works against Humanoids.
abilities.summary: Puts the enemy target in a state of meditation, incapacitating them for up to 6 sec.

abilities.note: Alliance mount. Horde Paladins learn Summon Warhorse with ID 1279399.
abilities.name: Summon Warhorse
abilities.text: Summons a warhorse, which serves as a mount.
abilities.summary: Summons a warhorse, which serves as a mount.

abilities.name: Summon Charger
abilities.text: Summons a Charger, which serves as a mount.
abilities.summary: Summons a Charger, which serves as a mount.

abilities.note: Horde Paladins' (Forsaken) mount; the Alliance uses Summon Charger.
abilities.name: Summon Forsaken Charger
abilities.text: Summons a Forsaken Charger, which serves as a mount.
abilities.summary: Summons a Forsaken Charger, which serves as a mount.

changes: Judgement no longer consumes your Seal and has a 10 sec cooldown. Swift Judgement (Protection talent) is a second Judgement with its own cooldown.
Seal of Fury is a new tanking seal from level 10: melee hits add Holy damage, with a shield they grant an absorb, and Judgement taunts.
Holy Strike is a new baseline melee strike (levels 6 to 60, 10 sec cooldown).
Consecration and Blessing of Kings are now learned from the trainer at level 20 instead of being talents.
New talent abilities: Oath of Light and Light's Vigil (Holy), Templar's Bulwark and Swift Judgement (Protection).
Holy Shock is now a row 5 Holy talent with a level 30 first rank.
Blessing of Salvation, Blessing of Light and Blessing of Sanctuary return nothing on the tooltip API and are not in the Forever spellbook.
conflicts: Repentance's tooltip says level 20, but wowforevertalent.com puts it in row 5 of Retribution (level 30). The table uses the row.
Method.gg marks Greater Blessing of Kings as a talent; its Wowhead tooltip is not a talent (level 60), so it is listed as trained.
Sanctity Aura (20218) still has a Forever tooltip (level 30, not a talent) but is not in wowforevertalent.com or Method.gg lists; it is left out.

Voice of Truth (1310897, level 20, 6 sec silence and interrupt immunity) has a tooltip but no talent flag. Kami-labs calls it a talent; wowforevertalent.com does not list it. Left out until its source is clear.
gaps: Turn Evil (Retribution row 5, new) was not found: no ID on the fan guides and none nearby on the tooltip API.
Paladin has no pets; no pet abilities apply.
Every rank after the first and the level it is trained at.
Quest-learned spells (Warhorse and Charger quest chains).
Passive talents, including the new passives (Consecrated Ground, Boundless Light, Stoicism, Iron Creed, Shieldsworn, Champion of the Light, Unsealed Wrath); passive_talents is left empty.
Revoke (1325499) returns nothing on the tooltip API and is left out.
